article.title: -아/어도
article.part: Concesión y terminaciones finales — 양보와 종결 어미
article.chapter: Concesión, fondo y contraste avanzado — 양보·배경·고급 대조

claims.summary: The article explains the usage of '-아/어도' in Korean, which expresses concession and indicates that a circumstance is insufficient to change the main result. It is similar to 'although', 'even if', or 'still' in English.

The article describes the formation of '-아/어도' by showing the alternation '-아/어-' in verbs, such as '가다 → 가도', '먹다 → 먹어도', and '피곤하다 → 피곤해도'. It also mentions that '-아/어도' can be used with both action and descriptive verbs.
The article compares '-아/어도' with '-더라도', stating that '-아/어도' is more neutral and frequent in general usage, while '-더라도' is more emphatic.
